_comment: Dated turning points of the era. kind: war | peace | pardon | pardon_end | economy. sides: two lists of factions. effects: what it does to the market and the world, in the same shape as story events' effects (scripts/economy/effects.gd). port: where it happened (its news then travels at sailing speed). unless_flag / if_flag: an event flag that prevents or allows it, so the player can change history (set rogers_stopped and Woodes Rogers never cleans up Nassau). Dates checked against the histories; the size of each effect is a design choice.

beyond_the_line.text: No peace beyond the line: French governors still commission buccaneers against Spain.

truce_of_ratisbon.text: The Truce of Ratisbon: France and Spain lay down their arms. French commissions against Spain are void.

nine_years_war.text: The Nine Years' War: England, the Dutch Republic and Spain against France. Letters of marque are easy to come by.

effects.reason: The earthquake, and the fever after it

port_royal_earthquake.text: An earthquake has swallowed half of Port Royal. Wharves, warehouses and two thousand souls are under the sea.

sack_of_cartagena.text: The French under Pointis, with the buccaneers of Saint-Domingue, have taken and sacked Cartagena. Its treasury is empty.

peace_of_ryswick.text: The Peace of Ryswick ends the Nine Years' War. Privateers are out of work.

spanish_succession.text: The War of the Spanish Succession: England and the Dutch against France and Spain.

treaty_of_utrecht.text: The Treaty of Utrecht. Thousands of privateers are paid off and many will turn pirate. Britain wins the asiento: one ship a year may trade at the Spanish fairs, and cover for a great deal of smuggling.

fleet_wreck_1715.text: A hurricane has wrecked the Spanish treasure fleet off Florida. Silver lies in the shallows, and every rogue in the Caribbean is sailing for the salvage camps.

kings_pardon.text: The King's Pardon: any pirate who surrenders to an English governor within the year will be forgiven.

woodes_rogers.text: Woodes Rogers has come to Nassau with men-of-war and the King's commission. The fences have gone to ground, and the gallows are going up.

kings_pardon_ends.text: The King's Pardon expires. Woodes Rogers' Nassau has no more mercy to give.

quadruple_alliance.text: The War of the Quadruple Alliance: England, France and the Dutch against Spain.

treaty_of_the_hague.text: The Treaty of The Hague ends the war with Spain.

south_sea_bubble.text: Word from London: the South Sea Company has collapsed, and half the City with it. Credit is gone, and English merchants aren't fitting out.

hurricane_1722.text: A great hurricane has wrecked Port Royal again: five feet of water in the streets, Fort Charles' guns dismounted, forty ships lost in the harbour.

hosier_blockade.text: Admiral Hosier's squadron is blockading Portobelo. The galeones won't sail while it holds.

anglo_spanish_war.text: War with Spain again: the Spanish have laid siege to Gibraltar.

treaty_of_seville.text: The Treaty of Seville makes peace between Britain and Spain.
